svg.text: WHAT IS PUBLIC RECORD, AND WHAT THIS DRAWING INVENTS

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: Raven Rock’s interior is CLASSIFIED. No public floor plan exists, and since 2007 US DoD policy has forbidden making "any photograph, sketch, picture, drawing, map or graphical representation" of the complex (references/manifest.yaml REF-015).

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: This sheet is an openly-labelled imaginative interpretation of a public landmark, drawn for a Minecraft build. It is NOT a map of the real facility, contains no classified information, and must never be presented as one.

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: FROM THE PUBLIC RECORD (setting and concept only) — the mountain is Catoctin greenstone / metabasalt, not granite [VERIFIED REF-003]; the caverns were blasted out, 1951–53 [VERIFIED REF-004]; the continuity-of-government / ANMCC command mission

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: [VERIFIED REF-010] and the 114th Signal Bn / DISA signals tenancy [VERIFIED REF-011]; freestanding multi-story buildings standing clear of the cavern walls on giant shock-isolation springs, with caverns separated by rock pillars [INFERENCE REF-005];

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: several hillside tunnel portals, most commonly said to be four, with tunnels curving gently to blunt a blast wave [INFERENCE REF-007 / REF-017]; self-sufficiency — on-site power, ventilation and underground reservoirs [INFERENCE REF-009].

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: INVENTED FOR THIS BUILD [CREATIVE] — every plan on this sheet: the five-zone scheme itself, all cavern outlines and sizes, all four building footprints and their arrangement, every tunnel and corridor route and curve, the four portal positions, the

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: blast-vestibule placements, the central rotunda, the reservoir count/size/position, the room lists, and the RR-Z5 shaft (a deliberate, droppable liberty). The FOUR-building count is a design choice between contested public claims of three

text.font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

svg.text: (Wikipedia) and five (popular sources) [REF-006]; "two reservoirs" and "dual power" are likewise popular figures, not authoritative [REF-009]. Every number quoted on this sheet describes the Minecraft build, not the real site.
